decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications:  02 (Rev B - 16.10.25), 03 (Rev B - 16.10.25) Received:  16 October 2025,  Unreferenced Fire Statement Received:  10 September 2025,  01 Received:  02 June 2025.  

Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - Before the building's two first floor flats hereby permitted are first occupied or brought into use, the Local Planning Authority shall be informed of the agreed naming and numbering of the proposed dwellings so that arrangements can be put in place to ensure that, with the exception of a person eligible for a disabled person's badge issued pursuant to Section 21 of the Chronically Sick and Disabled Persons Act 1970 (or similar legislation), no resident of the development shall obtain a resident's parking permit.  Any occupiers of the approved development shall surrender any such permit wrongly issued or held.

Reason: In order to protect the free flow and safety of traffic on nearby highways and to support sustainable transport objectives.

Condition : 4 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the first floor rear infill extension, first floor side extension and external alterations to the building hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.

Reason: In order to safeguard the appearance of the area in accordance with Local Plan Policies CC1, CC2 and CC4.

Condition : 5 - No additional windows or openings shall be formed in the first floor rear infill and side extensions to the building hereby permitted.  

Reason: In order to protect neighbours' privacy and the appearance of the building, in accordance with Local Plan Policies CC1, CC2 and CC4.

Condition : 6 - The development hereby permitted shall be fully implemented in accordance with the submitted Energy Statement (Ref: 114411) hereby permitted, including the installation of four solar panels (matching the submitted specification Ref: DMxxxM10RT-B60HBB) to the existing building's two storey rear outrigger flat roof, in accordance with the submitted Proposed Roof Plan (Ref: 03 (Rev B - 16.10.25)).  

Reason: In order to ensure that the development makes the fullest contribution to minimising greenhouse gas emissions in accordance with London Plan Policy SI2 and Local Plan Policy EQ1.

Condition : 7 - Prior to the first occupation of the building's two first floor flats hereby permitted, the development shall have been constructed to achieve an internal water use of 105 litres per person per day or less.

Reason: In order to protect and conserve water supplies and resources with London Plan Policy SI5.

Condition : 8 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external development and internal works associated with the change of use hereby permitted shall include:
(i)	At least 50% of any timber and timber products used being accredited with the Forest Stewardship Council (FSC) or Programme for the Endorsement of Forestry Certification (PEFC) scheme.
(ii)	No construction or insulation materials that would release toxins into the internal and/ or external environment, including those that deplete stratospheric ozone.

Reason: In the interests of sustainable development in accordance with London Plan Policy T7 and Local Plan Policy EQ2.

Condition : 9 - The building's two first floor flats hereby permitted shall not be occupied until the construction of the building's ground floor residential side entrance door and ground floor waste and cycle storage room (with a louvred ventilated side entrance door) and re-glazing of the building's existing first floor front and side windows (with removal of their existing ventilation fans), as previously granted by Planning Permission P/2025/0608, have been completed, and be permanently retained as such.  

Reasons: In order to ensure high quality and safe access, promote sustainable transport options and ensure adequate waste and recycling storage facilities for the two first floor flats hereby permitted, in accordance with London Plan Policy T2 and SI7 and Local Plan Policies CC2 and EC2.

Condition : 10 - The building's two first floor flats hereby permitted shall not be occupied until ground level Sheffield stand cycle parking facilities have been installed, with capacity to park at least four bicycles, within the building's ground floor waste and cycle storage room (as previously granted by Planning Permission P/2025/0608) only and been made available for exclusive use by residents of the two first floor flats hereby permitted only, and be permanently retained as such.  

Reason: In order to support sustainable transport objectives, in accordance with London Plan Policy T5 and Local Plan Policy EC2.

Condition : 11 - One 140 litre residual waste bin, one 55 litre plastic/ metal recycling box, one 55 litre cardboard/ paper recycling box, one 55 litre glass recycling box and one 23 litre food waste bin shall be made available for each of the two first floor flats hereby permitted within the building's ground floor waste and cycle storage room, as previously granted by Planning Permission P/2025/0608, in accordance with the Council's Recycling and Refuse Guidance:  Guide for Architects and Planners (August 2022), prior to each first floor flat's occupation.  

All waste and recycling bins used by and/ or waste relating to the building's two first floor flats hereby permitted shall be permanently stored within the building's ground floor waste and cycle storage room only, as previously granted by Planning Permission P/2025/0608.  The building's ground floor waste and cycle storage room shall permanently not be used to store bins and waste not relating to the two first floor flats hereby permitted.  

No bins or waste relating to the two first floor flats hereby permitted shall be stored on any public highway, or the privately owned communal rear access road and car park (used by the building's ground floor commercial unit) located to the rear of the site, at any time, except for during waste collection no earlier than twelve hours prior to and twelve hours after a planned collection time for the relevant waste type on a designated day.  

Bins and waste temporarily placed on a public highway for collection purposes shall be positioned on the adjoining public footway to the building in a location that would best limit pedestrian obstruction and safety risks only.   

Reasons:  In order to ensure adequate provision for waste and recycling storage, promote sustainable waste management, prevent public highway obstruction and nuisance and protect the character and appearance of the Conservation Area, in accordance with London Plan Policy SI7 and Local Plan Policies CC1, CC2 and E

Condition : 12 - No vehicles, motorcycles or bicycles owned or otherwise used by residents of or visitors to the building's two first floor flats hereby permitted shall be parked in the privately owned communal rear access road and car park (used by the building's ground floor commercial unit) located to the rear of the site at any time.  

Reasons: In order to promote sustainable transport options, limit vehicular traffic generation and prevent obstruction to the private access road located to the rear of the building (to which other neighbouring properties hold rights of access), in accordance with London Plan Policy T2 and Local Plan Policy EC2.
description: Erection of a first floor rear infill and side extension and installation of a first floor rear window to the building, change of use of the building's vacant first floor bank ancillary facilities (Class E) to one one-bedroom, two person flat and one two-bedroom, three person flat (Class C3) with associated internal alterations and installation of four solar panels to the building's roof.
